So What Did You Guys Think About This Years E3?

Positive: FF7 and Fallout 4 really made the show for me.

Negative: I was really hoping to see more information about the hololens FOV debacle but I didn't see anything about it (maybe I missed it?)
I'm really enjoying it. This "next gen" is really kicking in, in terms of game development. The amount of quality games announced has been fantastic in my opinion, really enjoying it.

Bethesda just dominated the presentations and left the rest looking quite a bit weaker. Looking forward to playing everything of theirs.

Microsoft annoucing XB1 backwards compat was really cool! Then, I saw how small the list of games was. I'm not an owner, but I hope the list grows for those who are. Also hoping Sony would attempt similar instead of the streaming service.

EA's presentation was great if you hate EA. Saddest thing I've seen. Couldn't even get pity laughs out of the audience around the time the Plants vs. Zombie segment was going. Cheers were in short supply after the short Mass Effect tease in general.

Ubisoft had a couple of titles I'm interested in, RB6 Siege and the Division. Glad to hear Siege has a single player element as a fan of the old games and SWAT. Division could be good. Signed up for the beta during the presentation.

Sony made me feel less buyer's remorse with the PS4. Might buy Last Guardian and Horizon.

Nintendo surprised me with StarFox Zero. Looks like a real StarFox game. Not much new info on the Yoshi game other than they have given it some difficulty, which makes be happy. Last few Yoshi games felt unloseable.

SquEnix surprised me too! Another NIER! Not soon, but it's happening. Few more details on Hitman 2015 confused me how IO Interactive can give out limited time assassination contracts without a subscription or making the contracts simple and bland. Just Cause 3 somehow looks more fun than 2. FFVII remake out of nowhere. What else can I say to that? Deus Ex: Mankind Divided showed off some gameplay and I'm still looking forward to playing it next year. I'd say that SquEnix gets silver if Bethesda gets gold.
I feel like every other game dev there thought "Shit... they just had to come out with Fall Out 4 huh, well we can still get some attention.. later FF7 remake?! ...pack up lets just go home"

Overall I was pretty underwhelmed. The three things I'm most interested in are Fallout 4, Deus Ex: Mankind Divided, and the new Hitman game. These are some great IP's that have a lot of promise, but have also stumbled at some point in the past. I'll be keeping up with them to see if they turn out to be good or disappointing.

Other than that E3 wasn't that exciting. It was fun to watch but I didn't walk away feeling like I had seen any groundbreaking material.
